project.name: claude-code-a11y
project.description: Accessibility mod for Claude Code aimed at blind developers. An overlay on the built-in screen reader mode (--ax-screen-reader) that adds what the mode lacks: spoken end-of-turn summaries, earcons for tool and permission events, a screen-reader-usable AskUserQuestion dialog, significance-filtered tool narration, speech on Windows, and automatic enabling of the mode when a screen reader is detected. Project of the Unlocked Spark Foundation.
project.author: Łukasz Majewski
project.adoption_notes: Repository existed as notes only (README and a Polish research note dated 2026-10-09, one commit). No code before ADD. Repository content is English; research notes under docs/research/ stay Polish. Repository private until first usable release.

maturity.next_promotion_criteria: Alpha: specs for the critical paths (screen reader detection and mode enabling, end-of-turn signal, AskUserQuestion dialog) in specs/; unit tests for the tool-call classifier and speech formatters in tests/unit; lint and typecheck in a pre-commit hook; manual test protocol with NVDA and VoiceOver written down in docs/; commit convention applied consistently.

languages.name: javascript
languages.version: Node 22 for tooling only (npm, Vitest, ESLint); the mod itself runs inside the Claude Code process

backend.runtime: Claude Code mod runtime (>= 2.1.287, type definitions checked for 2.1.295): hooks/hooks.json points at a TypeScript module exporting register(on, options)

frontend.framework: Claude Code mod surfaces (Spinner, ToolProgress, AskUserQuestion, ToolUse, ToolResult, AbovePrompt, Pane) plus $.audio, $.ui, $.process, $.fs APIs

database.type: none ($.store up to 4 MiB for mod state; ~/.claude/settings.json for axScreenReader)

cicd.notes: Manual: npm test, npm run lint, claude plugin validate . before each commit. GitHub Actions planned at Alpha.

local.manual_test: Full session with VoiceOver (macOS) and NVDA (Windows): install from shell, restart, prompt, answer an AskUserQuestion, approve a permission, hear end of turn.

production.deploy_trigger: manual: the repository is its own marketplace (.claude-plugin/marketplace.json); install from a clone with claude plugin marketplace add + claude plugin install; public /plugin install once the repository is public
verify: manual session with NVDA and VoiceOver

quality.coverage_notes: No coverage gate at POC. Target 50% of src/classify and src/speech at Alpha. Screen reader behaviour is verified manually; every sound must have a text equivalent that the screen reader can read.

source_control.commit_convention_notes: Imperative English sentence describing the effect, no type prefix, no AI attribution. Deliberate departure from conventional commits.

branding.source: Foundation brand shared with ../flint (accent oklch(0.42 0.13 258)); chrome in ../unlocked-spark-landingpage/src/
branding.tone: Confident and factual. No quoting of regulations, no emphasis on the foundation being young or small, no double dashes in public text. Invitations to contact phrased positively (rules in ../CLAUDE.md).
